title: Orthogonal degree-similarity of edge-deleted strongly regular graphs
summary: Godsil and Sun asked whether, for a strongly regular graph $X$ and any two different edges $e$ and $f$, the edge-deleted graphs $X\setminus e$ and $X\setminus f$ are degree-similar. We give an affirmative answer to the problem of Godsil and Sun. In fact, we prove the stronger statement that if $X$ is a $1$-walk-regular graph, then for any two edges $e$ and $f$ of $X$, the graphs $X\setminus e$ and $X\setminus f$ are orthogonally degree-similar.
